eps.ov: Momo vanishes after revealing his plot. Kyoichiro returns home to face a punishing family day.
Momo escapes despite Taiyo and Kyoichiro's pursuit, and Kyoichiro is summoned by Kai Izumo.
Taiyo and the spies race against time to stop shapeshifters from bombing HQ.
The Yozakuras track their missing siblings and face hostile spies at a local mall.

Shion has successfully booted the upgraded mass biometric analytical system for locating Momo Yozakura, Old Man Hunter 2. While she searches, Taiyo attempts to take his skills to the next level so that he can hold his own against Momo. Thanks to Kyoichiro's spartan training and Kai's support, Taiyo discovers his own way of fighting while manifesting Profuse Blooming of 10,000 Flowers. Just then, Shion reports that she's pinpointed Momo's location! The Yozakuras and the Gold Rank spies mobilize to bring Futaba and Shinzo home!

Kengo and Taiyo face off against the brainwashed Shinzo in a basement-level hallway of the Kaioumaru. As Shinzo's fighting seriously, now that he's activated his Blooming, they're purely on the defensive, but when they spot an opening, they try to contain him. Kengo uses his Blooming technique, Assimilation, to reverse the mind control by entering Shinzo's memories. There, he finds the walls plastered with fun-filled memories of Shinzo spending time with the family. As he advances further, he finds Shinzo's more recent memories, redacted by Momo, and Shinzo himself, staring at the monitor with lifeless eyes.
